caseName: Ariz. Sec'y of State's Office v. Feldman
caseNameFull: ARIZONA SECRETARY OF STATE'S OFFICE, applicants v. Leslie FELDMAN

opinions.text: Application for stay presented to Justice KENNEDY and by him referred to the Court granted. The injunction issued by the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit on November 4, 2016, in case No. 16-16698, is stayed pending final disposition of the appeal by that court.
